map.→ 打开播种日期计算器工具: -> Open the sowing date calculator tool
map.为什么还要留缓冲？: Why leave a buffer as well?
map.以品种审定公告的『生育期（天）』为准，并区分积温区。同一品种在不同纬度生育期会变: Take the "growth period (days)" from the official variety registration announcement and distinguish accumulated-temperature zones. The growth period of the same variety changes with latitude, so the recommended sowing date from the local agricultural extension service is the most reliable reference.
map.以目标收获日为锚点倒推：播种日 = 目标收获日 − 生育期。可填安全播种起始日期: Work backwards from the target harvest date: sowing date = target harvest date − growth period. You can enter a safe earliest sowing date as a lower bound; when the back-calculated date is earlier than that, the tool suggests postponing sowing.
map.倒推安全播种期：播种日 = 初霜预计日 − 生育期天数 − 安全缓冲（7~10: Back-calculate the safe sowing date: sowing date = expected first frost date − growth period in days − safety buffer (7~10 days).
map.光照累积量（每日光积分DLI）计算: Light accumulation (daily light integral DLI) calculation
map.填写「安全播种起始日期（可选）」。: Fill in "the safe earliest sowing date (optional)".
map.播种日 = 目标收获日 − 作物生育期（天）: Sowing date = target harvest date - crop growth period (days)
map.播种日期倒推器，根据作物目标收获期倒推适宜播种时间，帮助种植户把握最佳播期窗口、: Sowing date back-calculator: works backwards from the target harvest date of a crop to find the suitable sowing time, helping growers hit the best sowing window and plan farm work.
map.早霜年际波动大，缓冲天数抵消异常降温与收获延迟。越靠北、积温越紧，缓冲应越大。: Early frost varies a lot year to year, and the buffer days absorb abnormal cooling and delayed harvesting. The further north and the tighter the accumulated temperature, the larger the buffer should be.
map.生育期天数怎么取？: How is the growth period in days obtained?
map.种植密度计算器（株距×行距）（农业）: Planting density calculator (in-row spacing x row spacing) (agriculture)
map.结合当地常年终/初霜日统计确定窗口。: Set the window from the local long-term average last/first frost date statistics.
map.较喜温作物（如玉米、大豆）避免初霜前未成熟。: Warm-loving crops such as maize and soybean should avoid not ripening before the first frost.
map.：当地常年初霜在 10 月 15 日（年序第 288 天），玉米生育期约 120: : the local average first frost is 15 October (day 288 of the year), the maize growth period is about 120 days, and a 10 day buffer is kept. The latest sowing day ≈ 288 - 120 - 10 = day 158 ≈ 7 June. Sowing later than that risks frost damage.
